head: codex/45-doctor-split-repository-authority
title: [C-SDLC v2] Make doctor honor split repository authority
body:
Closes #45

## Summary

- record optional canonical code-repository authority during typed bind
- accept same-repository and explicit split routes while rejecting missing, unparseable, substituted, or mismatched authority
- preserve digest compatibility for pre-field live indexes and retained terminal receipts
- update active bind, doctor, publish, and runbook contracts
